name: Ice Troll King
overview: His special attack knocks the player backwards which can be negated with Protect from Magic or Protect from Missiles. Using Protect from Melee results in the Troll King knocking the player into the cave wall for very high damage, which can be done repeatedly. His defensive stats for Magic and Ranged are extremely high so melee is the best method to kill him. With melee armour, it is recommended to use Protect from Magic to minimise damage. His low Ranged level cannot hit as accurately or as strong as his Magic attacks. Protect from Magic will also stop his attack that is similar to Ice Barrage.

Wielding a Neitiznot shield will reduce the maximum hit of the Troll King's Ranged attack from 7 to 2 damage. Yak-hide armour does not grant any damage-reducing effect if worn in the fight against the Ice Troll King.

Rings of recoil can be used to great effect to kill him by standing at a distance where he will only use Ranged attacks. This method is slow, but if you are patient, bring enough food to heal approximately 200 hitpoints, 3-5 rings of recoil, and your best Range or Magic damage gear while having the Neitiznot shield equipped, he is almost a guaranteed kill without even using prayer. Simply click on the bridge to enter his lair, attack him, and don't move. He will only hit a max of 2 allowing you to recoil consistent damage. With a few hits from your range or magic he will go down eventually.
After the Ice Troll King is dead, decapitate his corpse and take the head to the Mawnis Burowgar to show that he has been defeated.
